arena: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9, two players, 2400-action limit
verification: The two environments started from the same seed. Every BatchObservation array, including legal action ordering, and every selected legal action index was checked before stepping both environments. The fork-reference and in-place native actions ran in alternating order to reduce timing-order bias. Any mismatch would have aborted the run. All 32 games finished normally with identical outcomes.
limitations: This verifies implementation equivalence, not independent strength, browser WASM latency or other rules profiles. Native CPU timings include different Python/fork overhead and are descriptive. The browser and rated agents remain unchanged.
